task.question: How many games did the Evansville Thunderbolts win to secure the President's Cup title in May 2026?
task.evidence: May 9: The Evansville Thunderbolts defeat the Peoria Rivermen three games to two to win their second consecutive and second overall President's Cup title.

answer: The Evansville Thunderbolts won 3 games to secure the President's Cup title in May 2026, defeating the Peoria Rivermen 3-2 in the series. FINAL: 3
